responsibility: This is the top-level Texinfo manual for the GNU C preprocessor. It assembles the standalone CPP documentation, organizing conceptual chapters on preprocessing language behavior, headers, macros, conditionals, diagnostics, invocation, and environment handling, and includes shared option and environment fragments such as @file{cppopts.texi}, @file{cppdiropts.texi}, @file{cppwarnopts.texi}, and @file{cppenv.texi}.
